name: @wildflowerhealthio/fhir-r4-adoption
description: The FHIR R4 side of extraction: how a resource decoded from a source becomes the device's own. adoptResource keys it under a local id derived from (system, type, source id), the system being the one its SystemFamily gives its type, and rewrites its references to land on their targets' local ids; DecodedId is the id it is adopted under (the source's own, or one generated from its content when the source gave none); adoptUnderRecognizedRoot adopts every resource a response kind parses under the SystemFamily its tryRecognize mints; adoptedReferenceOf spells a reference to an adopted resource from outside its source, and originalIdOf reads the source's id back off one. No DOM, no fs, no React.
